title: FBI director's Based Apparel site has been spotted hosting a 'ClickFix' attack
summary: PCMag reports that Kash Patel's Based Apparel merchandise website was discovered hosting a 'ClickFix' attack, a social engineering technique that mimics browser error dialogs to trick visitors into downloading and executing malware on their systems.
problem_solved: Documents and exposes a malware distribution campaign targeting visitors through a legitimate-looking e-commerce site.
why_valuable: Alerts the public about evolving social engineering threats and raises awareness about the risks of trusting websites associated with public figures.
